title: 第9章 礼该收就收第10章 事儿该拒就拒
lines: 魏乐府对那个名叫圆相和尚的大云光明寺叛徒也有所了解。
圆相属于第五代弟子，修炼的是纯正的佛家武学，走的是降龙伏虎一脉。
降龙功、伏虎桩以及罗汉劲。
八宝金身则是属于特殊类型的武学，所以不在练养打这三个范畴里。
其实力不弱，正面硬碰硬的情况下能无伤撂倒数名大汉的围攻，前提是这大汉不会武功并且没有受过专业训练。
正面撂倒其实不算什么，魏乐府也能够做到，主要是无伤。
无伤指的是连淤青、擦伤、抓伤、扭伤都没有，在多人混战中这一点极难。
即便一下都没被打到要害，仅仅是格挡对方胡乱挥来的拳头、挣脱撕扯，小臂、手背都极大概率会留下淤青和抓痕。
低武世界里就这样子，不要有太高的滤镜。
情报中还有着大云光明寺降龙伏虎一脉的武学特征以及应对方式。
首当其冲的就是摇人，然后一拥而上就行了。
后面才是讲解如何破招等等。
朝廷不愧是朝廷，所谓的江湖门派在朝廷这种庞大的国家机器面前跟没穿底裤差不多。
也就只有高武世界，才可能因为个人伟力出现一个人或者某个门派压制住朝廷的情况，低武世界里的门派真跟路边的野狗差不多。
魏乐府看完了情报后，就给田牧川送了过去，随后就带着老弟出了门。
不出意外，圆相十有八九是要来这松阳县的，只不过会是什么时候到，那他就不清楚了。
可能是今天，也可能是明后天，亦或者是早就到了，只不过他不知道对方躲在哪里。
所以他也只能进行摸排走访，不过这事也不能做的太明显。
一来可能打草惊蛇，二来泄露消息会引起松阳县其他势力注意，从而带来麻烦。
“丁大人，可否赏脸去醉花楼小酌几杯。”一名公子哥模样的人拦住了魏乐府的去路。
魏乐府认得对方，这人就是挂名在四方武馆里的二师兄方则言。
“如果你是为了给孟惟来当说客，那请回吧。”魏乐府生硬地说道。
对方突然找上门肯定是有事的，然而不管是什么事，魏乐府都不想惹麻烦。
毕竟对于他来说，当下还是先找到圆相和尚更为重要。
“哈哈哈，丁大人说笑了。”方则言哈哈一笑说道：“我并非是代表四方武馆而来。”
“而是代表方家，也不是来当说客的。”
“只是想与丁大人增进增进感情而已。”
然而魏乐府却摇摇头说道：“不了，我有公务在身，下次吧。”
他直接就拒绝了，嘴上这么说，谁知道是什么情况。
谨慎一点，防他一手再说。
至于说对方因此而针对自己？真要这么没脑子，方家也发展不到这么大。
他可以确定，田牧川这位铜章捕头以及松阳县的县令绝对不介意吃下这块大肥肉，让自己的腰包再鼓上一点。
方则言一听这话，就知道自己被四方武馆二师兄的挂名身份给拖累了。
事实上，他又不止是在四方武馆挂名，松阳县各个武馆都挂了名。
而且他对于‘丁守成’和四方武馆的恩怨压根就没有任何打算，纯粹就是过来拉拢送礼的。
这种待遇不只是魏乐府一个人享受过，其他铁尺捕快上任时都有的。
content_en:
Wei Yuefu also knew something about the traitor from Dayun Guangming Temple named Monk Yuanxiang.
Yuan Xiang belongs to the fifth generation of disciples. He practices pure Buddhist martial arts and follows the lineage of subduing the dragon and subduing the tiger.
Dragon Subduing Kung Fu, Fuhu Zhuang and Luohan Jin.
The Eight Treasures Golden Body belongs to a special type of martial arts, so it is not included in the three categories of training, training and fighting.
Its strength is not weak. In a head-on confrontation, it can defeat the siege of several big men without being injured. The premise is that the big man does not know martial arts and has not received professional training.
Knocking him down from the front is actually nothing, Wei Yuefu can do it, the main thing is that there is no injury.
No injuries means no bruises, abrasions, scratches, or sprains, which is extremely difficult in a multi-person melee.
Even if you are not hit to any vital point, if you just block the opponent's random fists, break away and tear, there will be a high probability of leaving bruises and scratches on the forearm and back of the hand.
This is how it is in the world of low martial arts, don’t have too high a filter.
The information also contained the martial arts characteristics and coping methods of Dayun Guangming Temple's lineage of subduing dragons and subduing tigers.
The first thing to do is to shake people, and then swarm them.
Later, I will explain how to break the moves and so on.
The imperial court is worthy of being a imperial court, and the so-called martial arts sects are as good as wearing no underpants in front of a huge state machine like the imperial court.
Only in the world of high martial arts can a person or a certain sect suppress the imperial court due to personal power. The sects in the world of low martial arts are really similar to wild dogs on the roadside.
After Wei Yuefu read the information, he sent it to Tian Muchuan, and then took his brother out.
Not surprisingly, Yuan Xiang was most likely coming to Songyang County, but he didn't know when he would arrive.
It might be today, it might be tomorrow or the day after tomorrow, or it might have been there a long time ago, but he didn't know where the other party was hiding.
So he could only conduct a walk-in visit, but he couldn't do it too obviously.
Firstly, it might alert others, and secondly, leaking the information would attract the attention of other forces in Songyang County, thus causing trouble.
"Master Ding, could you please go to Zuihua House for a few drinks?" A man who looked like a young master blocked Wei Yuefu's way.
Wei Yuefu recognized the other person. This person was Fang Zeyan, the second senior brother who was in the Sifang Martial Arts School.
"If you are here to be a lobbyist for Meng Wei, then please come back." Wei Yuefu said stiffly.
There must be something going on when the other party suddenly came to the door, but no matter what it was, Wei Yuefu didn't want to cause trouble.
After all, for him, it is more important to find Monk Yuanxiang first.
"Hahaha, Master Ding is joking." Fang Zeyan laughed and said, "I'm not here on behalf of the Sifang Martial Arts School."
"I am here to represent the Fang family, not to be a lobbyist."
"I just want to improve my relationship with Master Ding."
However, Wei Yuefu shook his head and said, "No, I have official duties. Let's do it next time."
He refused directly, saying so, who knows what the situation is.
Be cautious and guard against him.
As for the other party targeting me because of this? If they were really so brainless, the Fang family wouldn't be able to grow so big.
He could be sure that Tian Muchuan, the bronze-badged head catcher and the magistrate of Songyang County, would definitely not mind eating this piece of fat meat to enrich his pocket a little more.
As soon as Fang Zeyan heard this, he knew that he was being dragged down by his nominal identity as the second senior brother of Sifang Martial Arts School.
In fact, he is not only registered in Sifang Martial Arts School, but also in various martial arts schools in Songyang County.
Moreover, he had no plans at all for the grudge between 'Ding Shoucheng' and Sifang Martial Arts School. He just came here to win over and give gifts.
This kind of treatment was not only enjoyed by Wei Yuefu, but also by other Tiezhi agents when they took office.
title_en: Chapter 9: Accept the gifts when you should. Chapter 10: Say no when you should refuse.
